import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientRestriction
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientSections
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientStableAtlasMap

/-!
# Affine models of geometric quotients

The invariant-ring spectrum is a geometric quotient. Equivariant source
isomorphisms transport this calculation to affine schemes.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib

/-- The affine invariant-ring construction satisfies the geometric quotient
conditions on every open of its target. -/
theorem affineInvariantQuotientMap_isGeometricQuotient
    {k A G : Type u} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [Group G] [Finite G] [MulSemiringAction G A] [SMulCommClass G k A] :
    StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient (specAction G A)
      (affineInvariantQuotientMap (k := k) (A := A) (G := G)) where
  invariant := specAction_hom_affineInvariantQuotientMap
  isQuotientMap := affineInvariantQuotientMap_isQuotientMap
  eq_iff := affineInvariantQuotientMap_eq_iff_exists_specAction
  app_injective := InvariantLocalization.affineInvariantQuotientMap_app_injective
  mem_range_app := InvariantLocalization.affineInvariantQuotientMap_mem_range_app_iff_actApp

namespace StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
  {actY : G →* Aut Y} {q : Y ⟶ Z} (hq : IsGeometricQuotient actY q)

include hq in
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Transport a geometric quotient through an equivariant isomorphism of its
source. -/
theorem comp_sourceIso (actX : G →* Aut X) (e : X ≅ Y)
    (he : ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ (actY g).hom) :
    IsGeometricQuotient actX (e.hom ≫ q) := by
  have hinv (g : G) : (actX g).hom ≫ (e.hom ≫ q) = e.hom ≫ q := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, he, Category.assoc, hq.invariant]
  refine
    { invariant := hinv
      isQuotientMap := hq.isQuotientMap.comp e.hom.homeomorph.isQuotientMap
      eq_iff := ?_
      app_injective := ?_
      mem_range_app := ?_ }
  · intro x y
    change q (e.hom x) = q (e.hom y) ↔ _
    rw [hq.eq_iff]
    apply exists_congr
    intro g
    have h := congrArg (fun f => f x) (he g)
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h
    constructor
    · intro hg
      exact e.hom.homeomorph.injective (h.trans hg)
    · intro hg
      exact h.symm.trans (congrArg e.hom hg)
  · intro U
    exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (e.hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U))).injective.comp
      (hq.app_injective U)
  · intro U s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩ g
      exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom a)
        (app_actApp_of_invariant actX (e.hom ≫ q) hinv U g)
    · intro hs
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (e.hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U))).surjective s
      have htfix : ∀ g : G, (actApp actY
          (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant actY q hq.invariant U) g).hom t = t := by
        intro g
        apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (e.hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U))).injective
        have h := appLE_actApp_of_equivariant actX actY e.hom he
          (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant actY q hq.invariant U)
          (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant actX (e.hom ≫ q) hinv U) le_rfl g
        simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] at h
        exact (congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) h).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (actApp actX
            (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant actX (e.hom ≫ q) hinv U) g).hom ht).trans
              ((hs g).trans ht.symm))
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hq.mem_range_app U t).mpr htfix
      refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
      change (e.hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ((q.app U).hom a) = s
      exact (congrArg (e.hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ha).trans ht

end StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient

namespace StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {k G : Type u} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Finite G]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} (act : G →* Aut X) [X.IsSeparated]

/-- The quotient projection on a stable affine open satisfies the geometric
quotient conditions for its restricted source action. -/
theorem stableAffineQuotientMap_isGeometricQuotient
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (hact : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ p = p)
    (C : StableAffineOpen act) :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p C.U
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act C.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act p hact C.stable
    IsGeometricQuotient (restrictAction act C.stable)
      (stableAffineQuotientMap act p hact C) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p C.U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act C.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act p hact C.stable
  exact affineInvariantQuotientMap_isGeometricQuotient.comp_sourceIso
    (restrictAction act C.stable) C.affine.isoSpec
    (actRes_isoSpec_hom_specAction act C.stable C.affine)

end StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

namespace StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient

variable {k G : Type u} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Finite G]
  {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {act : G →* Aut X} {q : X ⟶ Y}

/-- A geometric quotient of an affine scheme by a finite group is affine.
The invariant affine base supplies the algebra presentation of the model. -/
theorem isAffine_target (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q) [IsAffine X]
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (hact : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ p = p) : IsAffine Y := by
  let C : StableAffineOpen act :=
    { U := ⊤
      affine := isAffineOpen_top X
      stable := fun g => by simp }
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p C.U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act C.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act p hact C.stable
  have hmodel := StableAffineOpen.stableAffineQuotientMap_isGeometricQuotient
    act p hact C
  have hsource := hq.comp_sourceIso (restrictAction act C.stable) X.topIso
    (restrictAction_hom_ι act C.stable)
  exact IsAffine.of_isIso (hsource.iso hmodel).hom

/-- The image of a stable affine open under a finite-group geometric quotient
is affine. This is the affineness assertion in Milne III.3.1. -/
theorem isAffineOpen_quotientOpen (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (hact : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ p = p)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) :
    IsAffineOpen (hq.quotientOpen U hU) := by
  let V := hq.quotientOpen U hU
  have hpre : IsAffineOpen (q ⁻¹ᵁ V) := by
    change IsAffineOpen (q ⁻¹ᵁ hq.quotientOpen U hU)
    rw [hq.preimage_quotientOpen U hU]
    exact hUa
  letI : IsAffine (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme := hpre
  apply (hq.restrict V).isAffine_target ((q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ p)
  intro g
  rw [← Category.assoc, restrictAction_hom_ι, Category.assoc, hact]

end StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient
end MilneLib
